description: Validates that newly created impulses are tracked in impulsesCreated array

impulsesLoaded.description: Empty array when no impulses are loaded

impulsesCreated.description: Array of newly created impulse IDs

contextRatio.description: Zero ratio when no impulses are loaded

tokens.description: Token breakdown with input, output, and cache fields

validationRules: impulsesCreated must be a non-empty array when impulses are created
impulsesLoaded may be empty if no impulses were loaded
contextRatio should be 0 when no impulses are loaded
tokens must be an object with input, output, and cache fields
